About

GitHub ↗ Resume

I'm an ambitious generalist with design at the core. Over the years I've learned to code, research, and think about business, and I'd rather find my own path than follow a well-worn one.

I think of myself as box-shaped: deep expertise across a few core disciplines, broad knowledge filling in around them, and empathy running through all of it. A genuine ability to understand the language, constraints, and goals of whoever I'm working with.

I'm the 6th man: not always in the spotlight, but reliable enough that teams move faster because of it. Stepping into strategy, systems, branding, or code as needed, seeing the full picture, and making sure every detail serves the larger vision. Lately that includes learning how to work with AI thoughtfully, finding where it genuinely helps and where it gets in the way.

Useful Clear Resonant Lasting

Things I've always cared about and tried to bring to every project. If the work isn't useful, nothing else really matters — but if it's also clear and built to last, that's when it starts to feel right.

I love solving a real need with something beautiful. Working with a great team to get there makes it better every time. I try to think big, move fast, and care about the details — always with an eye toward actually helping the people using it.
